### The Battle Is Mine
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/individual/the-battle-is-mine-1
Passage: 1 Samuel 17:47
Points:
- God magnifies His name through weakness rather than human strength, eloquence, or credentials.
- Intimidation is the enemy's main weapon to confuse believers and make them focus on the odds.
- David stayed confident because his eyes remained fixed on God rather than the giant.
- Real victory comes when we surrender our battles to God, knowing that they belong to Him.

### Four Steps to Defeat Your Giants
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-june-30-2025.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 17:45-46
Points:
- Remembering past instances of God's faithfulness gives us confidence to face present obstacles.
- Trust God with the gifts and tools already in hand instead of waiting for external advantages.
- Overcome discouragement by rejecting negative voices and strengthening yourself in the Lord.
- Expect God to act in your battles so that He receives all the glory.

### Day 20: 1 Samuel 17:31–58
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-20-1-samuel-17-3158.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 17:40
Points:
- David rejected Saul's bulky armor and remained authentic to the tools God gave him.
- Believers must evaluate the size of their obstacles against God's greatness rather than human strength.
- When placed in God's hands, modest resources and small steps can overcome massive hurdles.
- Victory does not rest on our self-confidence, but on the presence of the living God.
